title: רב יימר
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rav Yeimar ate on account of his wife, who was a priest’s daughter: Chullin 132a. He spoke to Rav Ashi: Gittin 77a, Ketubbot 95a, Bava Kamma 62a and 105a, Avodah Zarah 63b. He knew testimony for Mar Zutra and came before Amemar. Rav Ashi told Amemar: Shevuot 30b. He objected to Rav Kahana: Avodah Zarah 59a; he spoke to Rav Kahana, Bava Batra 171b. He accepted testimony from a witness reporting another witness concerning a firstborn animal. Mareimar applied to him: ‘Yeimar permits the firstborn’: Shabbat 145b and Bekhorot 36a. He came to Rav Pinchas be-Rav Ammi’s discourse. Rav Chaviva and Ravina: Ellu Terefot 51a. See part 1, year 4173, where he presided seven years.
